```{r}

library(dplyr)

burger <- read.csv("burger.csv")

```
```{r}

# data cleaning

burger <- burger %>%
  filter_out(best_burger_place %in% c("Not Sure", "Other"))

# b.

# one-way table

count_table <- table(
  burger$best_burger_place,
  dnn = "Best Burger Place"
)

count_table

pct_table <- prop.table(count_table) * 100

pct_table


# expected counts under the null hypothesis

expected_count <- rep(sum(count_table) / length(count_table),
                      length(count_table))
print(expected_count)


# chi-square test

chi_test <- chisq.test(count_table,
                       p = rep(1 / length(count_table),
                               length(count_table)))
print(chi_test)

```
